verification.notes: Because Owens explicitly qualified the claim as alleged, the verifiable question is whether such an allegation existed. A federal court record confirms Sophia Stewart alleged that her copyrighted work Third Eye formed the basis for The Matrix and pursued copyright claims; the record does not establish that the allegation was proven.

sources.title: Stewart v. Stoller — Report and Recommendation
sources.relevance: Federal court record confirms Stewart made copyright allegations involving The Matrix while also documenting that defendants later received summary judgment.
